title: NFL told the Jets, Raiders, Titans, Dolphins and Cardinals what they think of rebuilds. And it's not good

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL told the Jets, Raiders, Titans, Dolphins and Cardinals what they think of rebuilds. And it's not good
sources.description: While the league never overtly admits it, the prime-time freeze out is often absorbed as a message to team ownership about getting organizations into a competitive plateau from one season to the next.
